verdict.rationale: Logseq exposes a local HTTP API server and a plugin API that could in principle be scripted by an AI agent to act on many blocks/pages, and its query system can surface many matching items at once, but there is no documented native bulk-edit/batch-operation feature (e.g., bulk tagging, bulk move, bulk delete) in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation UI/API examples, confirmation that HTTP API supports batch/multi-item writes, independent evidence of AI agents performing bulk edits successfully.
